problem.eyebrow: The daily grind in every clinic
problem.title: We know how you work today, and where it's wasting your time
problem.subtitle: HealthyLife AI was built around the real problems that eat into a nutritionist's day without any real clinical payoff.
problem.card1Body: Following up on every client by hand — buried chat threads, lost meal photos, health notes split between messages and paper notebooks.
problem.card2Body: Hours lost every week in Excel and Word calculating calories per client and re-editing alternatives with every visit or dietary obstacle.
problem.card3Title: No idea who's fallen off track
problem.card3Body: Impossible to track who's still following the plan between sessions. You find out weeks — sometimes a month — later, once they've already disengaged.

howItWorks.eyebrow: A clinical workflow that just flows
howItWorks.title: How HealthyLife AI works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three deliberate steps that turn your clinic from manual admin into a system that watches over every client, around the clock.
howItWorks.step1Title: Add your client in a minute
howItWorks.step1Body: Just a name and phone number. Your client instantly gets an activation link over WhatsApp — no technical setup, no training needed.
howItWorks.step2Body: Pick meals from a rich local library, set flexible alternatives, and let the platform calculate macros and calories automatically and precisely.
howItWorks.step2Note: Cuts plan prep and editing time dramatically
howItWorks.step3Body: Instant, proactive alerts for anyone who's fallen behind or stopped logging meals, plus clear clinical summaries ready for the next follow-up.
howItWorks.step3Note: Pinpoints exactly who's at risk of dropping off

patientApp.title: What your client sees: clarity that drives adherence
patientApp.subtitle: An app built to feel intuitive and effortless for the client — no math, no clinical jargon.
patientApp.item1Body: Their meals and alternatives, clear in one tap — with options built from what's actually in their kitchen.
patientApp.item2Body: They log what they ate in seconds — either confirm the plan or pick the alternative they actually had.
patientApp.item3Title: Progress, right in front of them
patientApp.item3Body: Simple charts for weight, adherence, and water intake keep them motivated to stay on track toward their goal.
patientApp.item4Body: Their plan automatically becomes a smart weekly shopping list with the right quantities, ready before the supermarket run.

whyUs.title: Why nutritionists choose us
whyUs.subtitle: Not a translated import — designed together with practicing nutritionists and consultants across the region.
whyUs.reason1Body: A genuine RTL interface and a food database covering everyday local and Gulf dishes accurately — no literal translations, no unavailable Western ingredients.
whyUs.reason2Body: Your clients' data and health records belong to you alone, encrypted end to end and isolated to the strictest healthcare standards.
whyUs.reason3Body: Because real life changes plans, alternatives let a client stay on track without breaking their diet — meaningfully raising adherence and goal completion.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before bringing the platform into your clinic.
faq.q1Question: Do I have to drop Excel or paper immediately?
faq.q1Answer: Not at all. Start gradually with new clients or the cases that need closer follow-up — our team can also help import your existing client data.
faq.q2Question: How exactly does the AI work?
faq.q2Answer: It reads a client's daily meal logs and energy intake, and suggests alternative plan drafts based on their preferences. Most importantly, it watches logging patterns and alerts you the moment someone's adherence drops, so you can step in at the right time.
faq.q3Question: Does my client need to install a heavy app?
faq.q3Answer: No — a client can open and use the lightweight web app straight from a WhatsApp link, with nothing to install, or download the mobile app if they'd like regular daily reminders.
faq.q4Question: How do I get started, and how does onboarding work?
faq.q4Answer: It's simple: create your account, and you'll be ready to add your first client the same day. No sales calls, no setup fees.
